cases.name: 115 Round Hill Road — Garage Second-Story Addition

timeline.summary: Mr. Gilbert presented a proposal to add a second story atop an existing detached garage at 115 Round Hill Road, designed to exactly match the main house's roofline, siding, color, and finishes, consistent with a prior second-story addition already completed on another part of the property. Board members confirmed the garage is detached (so zoning has no issue with the added height) and that all exterior finishes will match the existing house exactly. After brief confusion over some members not having received the plan materials electronically, the Board voiced unanimous support and a motion was made, seconded, and approved.

meetings.meetingSummary: This was a very brief North Castle Architectural Review Board meeting conducted over Zoom, consisting of a single agenda item: review of a proposed second-story addition atop a detached garage at 115 Round Hill Road, presented by the project's representative, Mr. Gilbert. The Board found the design consistent with the existing house and approved it within a few minutes of discussion. After the applicant left, members briefly discussed an unrelated administrative matter — artificial red poinsettia decorations still displayed on a town building, now more visible against the snow — and asked staff to check whether the town code addresses such decorations, closing with a note that the next meeting is scheduled for March 16.

Multiple members can be heard responding during deliberation (e.g., several distinct 'I'm fine' remarks before a motion was seconded), indicating quorum was met, but no individual board member is named in the audio for this case.
